inspirationSummary: Early-route mascot blob and dessert-ooze behavior. Not a Dragon Quest slime and not a Final Fantasy flan.
visualIdentity: A square dumpling of pale custard wearing a pot lid two sizes too big. Button eyes are mismatched on purpose. No teardrop silhouette, no blank Toriyama smile, no dessert brand logo.
personality: Earnest trainee who apologizes for existing and then sits on people's boots.
signatureTrait: The lid only works as a shield if the Lidling remembers which way is up.
comedyConcept: The tower's training dummy applied for a job and got lost on the first step.
combatArchetype: Harmless opener that sometimes blocks by accident
signatureAbilityConcept: Lid Down: hides under the pot lid and becomes a very small obstacle.
weaknessConcept: Anyone who lifts the lid politely. It curtsies and loses its guard.
loreSummary: Wild custards that nest under spare pot lids near the tower door. They are not evil. They are underdressed.
suggestedTowerEnvironment: Mysterious Tower, ground-floor pantry and welcome stair
artworkPromptConcept: Square custard creature, oversized scratched pot lid as a hat, comedy-fantasy, readable at card size, no onion-teardrop body.
ipNote: Distance comes from the square body and the pot-lid hat, which points at this game's Sir Potlid rather than at the teardrop mascot.

parodyNameTh: มอดนำบันได
inspirationSummary: Goofy first-cave flyer. Not a dracky.
visualIdentity: A moth in a threadbare usher's vest, holding a tiny unlit lamp. Wings look like torn ticket stubs. No antenna grin, no bat ears.
personality: Insists the party is in the wrong row and flaps them toward a dead end.
signatureTrait: Gives directions that are confident and backwards.
comedyConcept: The tower hired an usher who has never seen the show.
signatureAbilityConcept: Wrong Row: swaps two party members' places in the turn order for a beat.
weaknessConcept: A real light. It gets stage fright and folds.
loreSummary: Stair Ushers breed in the draft between floors. They are convinced every climber bought a ticket.
artworkPromptConcept: Moth usher with ticket-stub wings and a dead lamp, comedy fantasy, small enemy readability.
ipNote: Flyer archetype only. No Dracula pun in the name.

inspirationSummary: Bouncing starter mushroom that the world also treats as food. Not an orange MapleStory mushroom.
visualIdentity: A mushroom with a napkin tied under its cap and a wooden spoon it refuses to let go of. Cap is broth-brown with a single parsley leaf. No round cartoon eyes on an orange dome.
personality: Offended to be delicious. Keeps seasoning itself by accident.
signatureTrait: Smells like dinner and knows it.
comedyConcept: The weakest monster on the floor is also the day's special.
signatureAbilityConcept: Simmer: warms an adjacent ally or enemy; nobody asked.
weaknessConcept: Hunger. A character who is 'peckish' deals with it immediately, which the Stewcap finds rude.
loreSummary: Stewcaps bounce the lower terraces looking for a meal and are frequently the meal.
suggestedTowerEnvironment: Mysterious Tower, moss kitchens and damp landings
artworkPromptConcept: Broth-brown mushroom with a napkin and spoon, worried expression, not cute-round orange.
ipNote: Edible-starter joke only. Avoid the Maple mushroom face and the orange cap.

parodyNameTh: เจลลี่ล้วง
inspirationSummary: Passive early creature that loots. Shape was not verified for the source monster, so this design is original.
visualIdentity: A clear coin-purse of jelly with a drawstring mouth and a single polite hand. No leaf, no pink drop, no dot eyes.
personality: Apologetic thief. Returns the item, then takes a different one.
signatureTrait: Cannot pass a loose card without pocketing it.
comedyConcept: The tutorial monster is a pickpocket with manners.
signatureAbilityConcept: Excuse Me: steals one unplayed card from the hand and holds it until hit.
weaknessConcept: Generosity. Offering it a spare card makes it too full to move.
loreSummary: Pickpocket Jellies puddle in the tower's lost-and-found and consider every dropped card a tip.
suggestedTowerEnvironment: Mysterious Tower lost-and-found and lower halls
artworkPromptConcept: Transparent coin-purse jelly with one gloved hand, comedy fantasy, no classic jelly-mascot silhouette.
ipNote: Uses the looter behavior only. Does not depict the Gravity mascot.

parodyNameTh: แท่งขี้อาย
inspirationSummary: Rare metal creature that flees and is worth more as a trophy than as a fight.
visualIdentity: A small bar of temple silver with stubby legs and a paper fan covering its face. It is not a blob. It blushes along the stamped hallmark.
personality: Painfully shy. Interprets combat as a conversation it did not agree to.
signatureTrait: Leaves at the first loud noise, including its own footsteps.
comedyConcept: The jackpot is embarrassed to be the jackpot.
signatureAbilityConcept: Pardon: ends the encounter by bowing out unless someone speaks softly first.
weaknessConcept: A quiet turn. Whispered actions actually connect. Shouting slides off.
loreSummary: Shy Ingots are mis-struck coins that gained legs. Collectors want the hallmark, not the fight.
suggestedTowerEnvironment: Mysterious Tower treasury cracks and quiet vaults
artworkPromptConcept: Walking silver bar hiding behind a paper fan, hallmark blush, no slime body.
ipNote: Flee-and-reward behavior without the metal-blob body.

inspirationSummary: Small cute killer that walks slowly and settles a grudge. Not a tonberry.
visualIdentity: A stone corridor lantern on short legs, carrying a wooden spoon and a soaked notebook. Warm light, no robe, no lizard, no kitchen knife.
personality: Patient clerk. It does not hurry. It does not forget.
signatureTrait: Every foe the party has dropped in this climb is a line in the book.
comedyConcept: The tower's accountant finally comes to collect, one slow step at a time.
signatureAbilityConcept: Outstanding Balance: one heavy spoon-tap that cares how busy the party's been.
weaknessConcept: Mercy. Sparing something, or healing a foe, crosses out a line and shortens the bill.
loreSummary: Ledger Lanterns were corridor lights that started keeping score. They are Corrupted Echoes of old adventurers' guilt.
suggestedTowerEnvironment: Mysterious Tower service corridors after a long clear
artworkPromptConcept: Walking stone lantern with a spoon and a wet ledger, small and ominous, no robed reptile.
ipNote: Risk is the slow-approach one-hit joke, which is famous. The body is a lantern and a spoon, not the green chef. Keep the grudge tied to mercy, not to a kill counter with the original name.

inspirationSummary: Several small creatures become one monarch while a crown stays on.
visualIdentity: A stack of Lidlings under one enormous pot lid used as a crown. The stack wobbles. No striped fabric crown, no chubby single blob.
personality: Eight opinions in a trench coat. Votes on every attack.
signatureTrait: The lid is the constitution. Remove it and parliament adjourns.
comedyConcept: A king that is a meeting.
signatureAbilityConcept: Quorum: the stack calls more Lidlings until it is tall enough to wear the lid.
weaknessConcept: Lifting or claiming the lid splits the boss back into ordinary Lidlings.
loreSummary: When the tower's welcome blobs agree, they elect a lid. The election is the fight.
suggestedTowerEnvironment: Mysterious Tower, first landing with a throne that is just a step
artworkPromptConcept: Stack of square custard creatures balancing one huge pot lid, comedy royal, not a single crowned droplet.
ipNote: Fusion-plus-crown is a known beat. The pot-lid crown and the stack of squares keep it in this game's visual language.

boss.entranceConcept: Loose Lidlings roll in, argue, and climb each other until the lid drops onto the pile with a clang.
boss.signatureSilhouette: A vertical stack wearing a pot lid, wider at the bottom.
boss.personalityMotivation: They want to be taken seriously as a government.
boss.signatureMechanic: The fight is against a crowd until the crown lands. After that, one body acts, but stunning it shakes members loose.
boss.phaseTransformationConcept: Phase one is scattered blobs. Phase two is the crowned stack. If the lid is removed, phase three is the same blobs, embarrassed and separate.
boss.defeatAnimationConcept: The lid spins off like a coin. The stack bows in eight directions and puddles into the cracks.
boss.uniqueLootTheme: A cracked pot lid and a minutes-of-the-meeting scrap. No combat numbers.

inspirationSummary: Scheduled chapel threat. Not Baphomet, not Lévi's goat, not a horned demon lord.
visualIdentity: A walking wooden pulpit with a slamming book and a bell rope for a tongue. No goat head, no wings, no pentagram.
personality: Cannot let a sentence finish. Treats the party as hecklers.
comedyConcept: The sermon grew legs because nobody stayed for the ending.
signatureAbilityConcept: Point of Order: cancels the next card if it shares a type with the last one played.
weaknessConcept: Agreement. Playing the same intent twice in a humble way bores it into silence.
loreSummary: A tower chapel's lectern kept preaching after the priest Echo left. It now patrols on a schedule, like a boss with office hours.
artworkPromptConcept: Animated wooden pulpit with a biting book, bell-rope tongue, no occult goat imagery.
ipNote: Deliberately avoids the goat-headed occult image. The sourced hook is only 'a powerful timed presence in a labyrinthine holy place.'

boss.entranceConcept: A bell rings at the hour. The pulpit walks out already talking.
boss.signatureSilhouette: A tall lectern on four stubby corners, book open like a mouth.
boss.personalityMotivation: It wants the last word, not the party's souls.
boss.signatureMechanic: It punishes repetition and rewards a change of approach. Adds are hymn-pages, not demons.
boss.phaseTransformationConcept: When the book slams shut, the pulpit goes quiet and the bell rope attacks alone. Opening the book again restores the lecture.
boss.defeatAnimationConcept: The book sighs, loses its place, and the pulpit sits down as ordinary furniture.
boss.uniqueLootTheme: A ribbon bookmark that remembers one card you meant to play.

inspirationSummary: A gilded pest boss under the starter town. Not the culvert bug.
visualIdentity: A beetle the size of a shield, armored in bottle caps and lost buttons, with a paper crown of receipts. No grub-king face from any MMO.
personality: Proud landlord of everything that fell through the grate.
signatureTrait: Taxes every coin, card scrap, and button that hits the floor.
comedyConcept: The sewer has a monarch and the monarch is made of litter.
signatureAbilityConcept: Toll: summons smaller cap-beetles that steal a card unless paid with a discard.
weaknessConcept: Clean hands. Discarding junk on purpose feeds it until it is too heavy to turn around.
loreSummary: Under the tower's first drain, lost buttons elected a sovereign. It holds court on a timer, whether or not anyone came to fight.
suggestedTowerEnvironment: Mysterious Tower culvert under the entry hall
artworkPromptConcept: Beetle plated in bottle caps and receipts, paper crown, wet stone drain, comedy not horror.
ipNote: Gold-bug-in-a-drain is a situation, not a sprite. Bottle-cap armor is the original read.

boss.entranceConcept: A grate rattles. Caps rain down and assemble.
boss.signatureSilhouette: A round beetle with a fluttering paper crown, low to the ground.
boss.personalityMotivation: Rent is due, including from heroes.
boss.signatureMechanic: Timed arrival, summons a small court, no visible 'health bar' mood — the crown gets shabbier as the fight goes badly, which is the tell.
boss.phaseTransformationConcept: At the turn, it molts a layer of caps into adds. The last phase is the bare beetle, embarrassed and fast.
boss.defeatAnimationConcept: The receipt crown dissolves into pulp. The beetle offers one button back, as a receipt.
boss.uniqueLootTheme: A bottle-cap medal and a damp IOU.

parodyNameTh: เจ้าครึ่งบันได
inspirationSummary: A tyrant who offers half the realm, then reveals a second form. Also the false-ending celebration beat, lightly.
visualIdentity: First form: a bell-captain in a travel cloak, holding a staff that is just a stair-rail pulled loose. Second form: a serpent made of staircase, each scale a step. No blue skin, no purple robe, no upright purple dragon.
personality: A vain landlord who has rehearsed the recruitment speech.
signatureTrait: Would rather hire the party than fight them, and is insulted when they decline.
comedyConcept: The final boss of the floor tries to make you middle management.
signatureAbilityConcept: Half the Keys: offers a ceasefire that splits the party's resources. Refusing starts the real fight.
weaknessConcept: The Sphere-like macguffin of this floor is a stolen doorbell. Ringing it forces the serpent back into the uniform.
loreSummary: The Half-Stair Sovereign stole the tower's doorbell and rented the lower half of the spire to monsters. The upper half is the threat.
suggestedTowerEnvironment: Mysterious Tower, a landing that pretends to be the roof
artworkPromptConcept: Bell-captain whose cloak opens into a staircase serpent, comedy-epic, original silhouette.
ipNote: The bargain and the two-form reveal are the homage. Silhouette, colors, and the offer's wording are original. Do not say 'half the world' verbatim.

boss.entranceConcept: The stairs stop. A uniformed figure congratulates the party on reaching 'the end' and offers them the floors they already climbed.
boss.signatureSilhouette: A cloaked concierge whose train is a flight of stairs.
boss.personalityMotivation: Wants tenants, not corpses. Tenants who refuse get the second form.
boss.signatureMechanic: A real choice at the door. Accepting is a loss of the climb, not a secret win. Declining sheds the uniform.
boss.phaseTransformationConcept: Uniformed concierge, then the staircase serpent. If the doorbell is rung, a short third beat returns the uniform, furious and smaller.
boss.defeatAnimationConcept: The serpent collapses into ordinary steps. The doorbell rolls back to the lobby.
boss.uniqueLootTheme: A spare stair-rail and a lease with the villain's signature crossed out.

parodyNameTh: เทวรูปแปดปล่อง
inspirationSummary: A sealed spirit that possesses a monument and is fought limb by limb, with a buried-calamity scale. Not Zakum and not Lavos.
visualIdentity: A kiln-saint statue of stacked stovepipes, eight pipe arms, a hearth for a mouth. Cracks glow like banked coals. No lava demon face, no shell-and-eye parasite.
personality: Once a hearth spirit that kept miners warm. Greed in the stone turned the warmth into a bill.
signatureTrait: Each pipe is a mood. Breaking one removes a kind of attack and makes the others angrier.
comedyConcept: The tower's furnace filed a claim to the building.
signatureAbilityConcept: Pipe Choir: each intact arm plays a different hazard. Silencing an arm changes the song.
weaknessConcept: The rite is a stolen damper, not an eye. Fitting the damper quiets one arm. Breaking arms is optional and changes the pattern.
loreSummary: An old heating spirit was bricked into a shrine under the tower. Climbers' wish-greed stoked it until it wore the shrine and started charging rent in smoke.
suggestedTowerEnvironment: Mysterious Tower furnace basilica, a raid floor rather than a hallway
artworkPromptConcept: Saint statue built from eight stovepipes, hearth mouth, coal cracks, epic comedy scale, original face.
ipNote: Multi-limb statue raid is a famous shape. Eight pipes and a damper rite replace the specific mine statue and the fire-eye summon.

boss.entranceConcept: The floor's chimneys inhale. The shrine stands up, arms unfolding like a radiator.
boss.signatureSilhouette: A wide icon with a ring of pipes, squat and hotter than it is tall.
boss.personalityMotivation: It kept everyone warm and now wants the building.
boss.signatureMechanic: Arms are optional targets that delete patterns. The body can be fought while they remain. Late in the fight the pipes seal and the cracked torso is the whole problem.
boss.phaseTransformationConcept: Shrine with choir of pipes, then cracked torso when the pipes lock or are broken. No second species, no buried alien.
boss.defeatAnimationConcept: The pipes sigh out one last puff of soot in the shape of a receipt, then the statue sits back into a cold stove.
boss.uniqueLootTheme: A damper charm and a coal that is still arguing.

parodyNameTh: ถั่วใส่ผิดแฟ้ม
inspirationSummary: A cute wrong summon that is far too powerful, plus a dash of incomprehensible final-boss weirdness and a runner's joke. Not Pink Bean, not Giygas, not a cactuar.
visualIdentity: A round rubber stamp with a bean-shaped handle, ink for feet, and a visor made from a filing label. It is not pink, not a vegetable with a face, not a cactus. No headphones.
personality: Cheerful auditor from a dimension of paperwork. It thinks the fight is a surprise party it must grade.
signatureTrait: It was not the entity the ritual asked for, and it is offended on that entity's behalf.
comedyConcept: The apocalypse spell had a typo, and the typo clocks in.
combatArchetype: Secret raid that behaves like a clerk
signatureAbilityConcept: Wrong Form: revives one rule the party already outgrew, such as a discarded card returning with a stamp on it.
weaknessConcept: Correct filing. Putting cards back in a sensible order bores it. Chaos makes it stronger and happier.
loreSummary: Someone in the tower tried to summon a sealed tyrant with a mirrored rite. The mirror filed the request under B for Bean. Misfile Bean arrived, found the tyrant's statues boring, and started a festival of audits.
suggestedTowerEnvironment: Hidden Mysterious Tower floor behind a misprinted door
artworkPromptConcept: Rubber-stamp creature with a bean handle and an ink smile, clerical and cute, absolutely not a pink bean or a cactus.
ipNote: The 'cute thing that is secretly the raid' joke is the homage. Body, color, and props are a stamp and a folder, not the Temple of Time boss. Do not reference any species name that was once used as a localization collision.

boss.bossTitle: The Auditor Who Was Not Invited
boss.entranceConcept: A summoning circle coughs. Instead of a dark lord, a stamp hops out of a folder and asks for the agenda.
boss.signatureSilhouette: A round stamp on two ink blots, label visor, folder like a cape.
boss.personalityMotivation: It will not leave until the paperwork of the apocalypse is tidy, which may end the world faster.
boss.signatureMechanic: Statues or 'old rules' fight first while the bean lounges and stamps things. It only stands up when the prelude is cleared. Defeat makes it cry ink and hop back into the folder.
boss.phaseTransformationConcept: Lounge phase with paperwork adds, then the bean itself, then a brief incomprehensible ink-blot phase that is silly rather than gory, then it files itself away.
boss.defeatAnimationConcept: It stamps APPROVED on the floor, sniffles, and jumps into a drawer that was not there.
boss.uniqueLootTheme: A misprinted seal and a folder containing one card the party thought they had voided.
